gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-funnel-sans: Conthrax stretches its lowercase so far upward that capitals nearly blend in, with a wide-mouthed a adding a geometric, machined look. Funnel Sans keeps its strokes uniform, so paragraphs unspool like one thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-gafata: Conthrax has the thickness of neon glass tubing, with a wide-mouthed a and geometric lines that look machined. Gafata is plain sans and far lighter; that weight gap is the draw.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-georama: Conthrax keeps stems and arcs in lockstep, every glyph a geometric, clean shape with a wide-mouthed lowercase a. Georama, with its bracelet-like open c, makes long paragraphs feel approachable.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-golos-text: Conthrax stretches its lowercase until capitals barely stand apart, a clean geometric display face with a wide-mouthed a. Golos Text, sans-serif, fills the line with generous lowercase and a single stroke width.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hedvig-letters-sa: Hedvig Letters Sans has small letters that nearly reach capital height and a clear gap where the c ends. Conthrax, drawn at a single stroke width, leads into text that feels approachable and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-heebo: Neutral by nature, Heebo keeps a generous central band of text and curves that stop short instead of closing. Conthrax holds its stroke width constant, and Heebo, plain sans, loosens it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur leaves wide gaps between curve ends and stems, its lines holding steady like a steel cable outline. Beside Conthrax's wide-mouthed a, this sans feels like stamped metal type.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hind-mysuru: Conthrax is a geometric, clean display face whose wide-mouthed a and stretched lowercase look cut from a single thread. Hind Mysuru, sans-serif with no calligraphic thinning, is the pair's steady counterweight.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hind-vadodara: Spacious terminal gaps and large bowls in the e and a give this sans an unhurried, uniform feel. Hind Vadodara and Conthrax share a constant stroke, and that is the strongest link.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-huninn: Huninn holds its s terminals away from the body, lowercase rising near cap height, crossbars as fat as the stems. Huninn, sans next to Conthrax, reads best with a touch more size.
